rv.q: Solid, and occasionally even nuanced, this new production has its merits certainly, but fails to generate that peculiarly anarchic delight that is such comedy at its best.
Ultimately even these two stalwarts fail to ignite the play.

cn.t: This elegant revival of Sheridan's comedy offers graceful production values and infectious chemistry between its leads, but critics find it lacks the fire and passion needed to fully ignite.
